build.prompt: In this repository, whenever you make code changes, bump the crate version in Cargo.toml exactly once per PR using semantic versioning. Use MAJOR for breaking changes, MINOR for backward-compatible features, and PATCH for fixes, refactors, tests, docs, and chores that do not break compatibility. If the PR already includes a version bump, do not bump again (even across multiple commits). Mention the chosen bump level in your final summary.

bump-version.description: Bump Cargo.toml once per PR using semver
bump-version.template: Update Cargo.toml package.version exactly once for this PR using semantic versioning (major for breaking changes, minor for new backward-compatible features, patch for fixes/chore/docs/tests/refactors). If already bumped in this PR, do not bump again. Return the old and new versions and a one-line rationale.
